scope: sampled visual and story review; ASR and measured signal support; no validated audio listening
product_from_film: Lovable builds websites and apps from prompts, with collaboration, visual editing, custom domains and code access.
explains_well: The shopping-site example shows a first prompt and a specific follow-up that adds a profile sidebar.
unclear: The film switches projects between creation, collaboration and publishing, so viewers do not see one app completed through all stages.
scenario: Generate a shopping site, refine it, invite collaborators, edit and publish.
product_clear_basis: The social-shopping request becomes a visible storefront inside the builder.

scenes.action: Gradient spheres and typing text introduce the claim that few people code, then Lovable appears with speed and app-creation claims.
scenes.design: Cream fields, pink-blue-orange gradients and large kinetic type.
scenes.purpose: Frame app building as accessible to more people.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 0–19s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Website examples lead to a prompt for a social shopping marketplace. A storefront appears; a follow-up requests a user-profile, stats and balance sidebar, which appears in the result.
scenes.design: Glowing rounded frame around a dark chat and white app preview.
scenes.purpose: Show creation and a targeted refinement.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 19–33s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Now with collaboration introduces Invite controls, an email field, owner/editor roles, avatars and a shared dashboard with named cursors.

scenes.purpose: Show team access and shared work.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 33–41s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Edit mode selects a page heading. A text panel changes the headline to Organize Smarter, Maximize Results, then size and color controls change its styling.

scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 41–54s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Publishing and custom domains are introduced. Publish dialogs list example domains, followed by a browser page and a laptop view of another finished site.

scenes.purpose: Present a path to a public site.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 54–63s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Dev mode opens a file tree and code editor. Titles say code can be edited on the spot or in GitHub.
scenes.design: Dark code surface and gradient title cards.
scenes.purpose: Offer a deeper control path for developers.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 63–72s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

scenes.action: Now it is your turn and What are you building lead to the Lovable mark and lovable.dev.
scenes.design: Grainy gradients, white type and heart-like symbol.
scenes.evidence: Visible chronological 1 fps samples, source 72–80.4s; boundary approximate; exact motion between samples unverified.

lessons.keep: Show one specific follow-up edit after the first generated result.
lessons.avoid: Combining several projects into an apparently continuous end-to-end workflow.
lessons.open: Build quality, real collaboration, publishing state, performance claims and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, generate one campaign page, then add a clearly requested signup panel before inviting a teammate.
Carry the same shopping project through collaboration and publishing to reduce example switching.

comparison.story: Frame app building as accessible to more people. → Show creation and a targeted refinement. → Show team access and shared work. → Show direct visual refinement. → Present a path to a public site. → Offer a deeper control path for developers. → Invite the viewer to start.
